requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

661-803-1486-4231--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Arcane Adaptation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Sculpting Steel. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Arcane Adaptation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

4210-4279-5075--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4210-4279-5075--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1719-2645-3430-4717.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1719-2645-3430-4717.description:
Activate City of Traitors by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping City of Traitors
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7932.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
5256-6972-7932.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ceti Eel.
When Ceti Eel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ceti Eel enters, it triggers, causing you to mill two cards and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

997-2178-5931-5970.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
997-2178-5931-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Awakening Hall.
Awakening Hall triggers, returning all creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing one of the returned creatures.
When the creature dies, Marina triggers, and Funeral Room triggers if it's unlocked.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, if applicable, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Awakening Hall.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 once.
Repeat from step 1.
997-2178-5931-5970.notes: If you start the combo with Funeral Room locked, you can still unlock it with Marina if you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard. During the first loop, you'll want to repeat steps 3 through 8 one additional time, instead choosing to unlock Funeral Room. Additional Marina triggers can allow you to lock and/or unlock other Rooms as desired.

2468-6587-6588-7715.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

240-643-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-643-5686.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

372-2239-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2239-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1978-5776-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least six mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat

730-997-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

5524-5702-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5524-5702-6441.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Destiny Spinner
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

4499-4772-7009.manaNeeded: {3} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
4499-4772-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Doubling Season.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

2173-3025-5073-5220.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

789-2399-5256--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
789-2399-5256--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing that creature.
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Ooze.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
If the Altar of Dementia abilities, milling target player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power each time.
Repeat.
789-2399-5256--129.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

565-1858-6747--118.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
565-1858-6747--118.notablePrerequisites: You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
565-1858-6747--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

3918-4222-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least two.
3918-4222-4306.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

1742-2793-3743-4365-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
1742-2793-3743-4365-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

643-1429-2921-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-2921-5402.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1379-2043-2493-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {8}{U}{U}.
1379-2043-2493-4276.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Turnabout to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to proudce at least {9}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which can be used to activate Urza's ability infinitely and/or cast Turnabout choosing its other modes.

104-4490.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Cleric Class is at least level two.
104-4490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain two life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2308-2685-3263-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-2685-3263-4659.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token that is also an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
The Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Teething Wurmlet.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Teething Wurmlet trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

262-812-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Chained Brute.
Chained Brute does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
262-812-2034.description:
Activate Chained Brute by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Chained Brute by paying {1} and sacrificing an Elemental, untapping Chained Brute.
Repeat.

570-876-4499.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four colors among permanents you control.
570-876-4499.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Faeburrow Elder.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Emiel.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.

1211-4603.description:
At the beginning of your draw step, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose three life, then search your library for a card and put it into your hand.
During each opponent's draw step, Maralen triggers, causing them to lose three life, then causing you to search their library for a card and exile it.
You may play cards exiled this way due to Opposition Agent.
